title: 欢迎来到 Plyra Community 预览版
author: Plyra Team · 演示账号
body:
欢迎来到 Plyra Community 的本地原型。这里的帖子是随项目附带的演示数据，不代表真实公告，也不会从 GitHub 读取或发布内容。

我们的目标是让桌面用户可以自然地浏览讨论、开发日志和 MOD 元数据，同时把 GitHub 细节留在服务适配层。

这个页面使用 Godot Control 节点绘制。界面本身不需要 3D 场景，也不要求安装 Plyra Compositor 或 Steam 沙盒。

你可以尝试缩放窗口、切换社区和 MOD 页面、搜索中文内容，并在设置页的输入区试用本机中文输入法。演示文本、搜索词与设置页试输入仅存在于当前应用进程中。

comments.body: 本地预览能正常显示中文和长文本。

replies.body_en: We will check the input experience on a real Android device in a later round.

comments.body_en: The local preview displays Chinese text and long-form posts correctly.

comments.author: Ari · 演示账号
comments.body: 帖子旁的图片来自项目内置样例，不会访问第三方图片服务。

title_en: Welcome to the Plyra Community preview
body_en:
Welcome to the local Plyra Community prototype. These posts are bundled demo content; they are not official announcements, and nothing is read from or published to GitHub.

Our goal is to make it natural for desktop users to browse discussions, devlogs and MOD metadata, while keeping GitHub details inside service adapters.

This page is built with Godot Control nodes. It does not need a 3D scene, Plyra Compositor or Steam sandbox.

Try resizing the window, switching between Community and MODs, searching English or Chinese content, and using the input area in Settings to try your local IME. Demo text and searches stay in this app session.

title: 开发日志：从可复用的桌面 UI 开始
author: Plyra Team · 演示账号
body:
这份开发日志是演示内容，用来检查标题、作者、更新时间与长正文的阅读布局。

Plyra 的桌面、世界和社区界面未来可能共享一套视觉基础，但社区客户端保持独立启动。它不会假设合成器、窗口管理器扩展或 Steam 容器已经运行。

当前原型把实体定义放在 scripts/models，把可替换的内容来源放在 scripts/services，把导航与视图放在 scenes 与 scripts/ui。模型只包含普通字典字段，UI 没有调用 GitHub GraphQL。

读取公开内容时，正式版本可以先用 GitHub Actions 生成静态 JSON，再由客户端下载。需要用户身份的写入操作则走单独的 GitHub 授权与 Discussion API 适配。两条路径都不需要常驻数据库或社区服务器。

后续会实测中文输入法、长文本滚动、图片加载与窗口休眠后的恢复，并在 Android 设备上检查软键盘与视口调整。这些平台验收尚未在本次本地预览中完成。

演示正文有意保留多段内容，便于查看行距、段落间距和滚动手感。这里的字符串以纯文本展示，不会将外部 Markdown、脚本或第三方代码直接执行。

comments.author: Mika · 演示账号
comments.body: 把服务接口从场景抽出来，后面接静态 Feed 会更容易。
comments.body_en: Keeping the service interface outside the scene will make a static feed easier to add.

title_en: Devlog: Start with a reusable desktop UI
body_en:
This sample devlog helps check title, author, update date and long-form reading layout.

The desktop, world and community interfaces may share a visual foundation in the future, while the community client remains independently launchable. It never assumes that a compositor, window-management extension or Steam container is already running.

The prototype keeps models in scripts/models, replaceable content sources in scripts/services, and navigation and views in scenes and scripts/ui. The UI does not call GitHub GraphQL.

Public content can later use a static JSON feed generated by GitHub Actions. User-authored posts and replies can use a separate GitHub authorization and Discussions API adapter. Neither path needs a persistent database or community server.

Later work will verify Chinese IME composition, long-form scrolling, image loading and resume after sleep, including on Android. Those platform checks are not part of this preview.

This intentionally long sample makes it easier to judge line height, paragraph spacing and scrolling. Text is displayed as plain text; external Markdown, scripts and third-party code are never executed.

title: 如何在预览版里检查搜索和分类？
author: Nora · 演示账号
body:
打开 Community 页面后，可以用搜索框按标题、正文、作者或分类过滤样例讨论。输入“桌面”“输入”或“GitHub”试试看。

分类筛选当前只处理本地演示数据。它不会请求网络，因此即使离线，页面仍然可以交互。

comments.author: Kai · 演示账号
comments.body: 切到“开发日志”后，再搜索“界面”可以组合筛选。
comments.body_en: Choose Devlogs, then search for “interface” to combine the filters.

title_en: How do I try search and filters?
body_en:
Open Community to search sample discussions by title, body, author or category. Try words such as “desktop”, “input” or “GitHub”.

Category filters currently use local demo content only. They make no network requests, so the page stays interactive offline.

title: 想优先看到哪些 Plyra Desktop 讨论？
author: Ari · 演示账号
body:
这是一条本地示例讨论，用来展示用户头像替代文本、评论计数和回复预览。

GitHub 登录、创建帖子、评论和编辑本人内容会在接入真实社区仓库后，通过当前账号身份执行。本原型没有个人访问令牌输入框，也没有管理员代发逻辑。

comments.body: 我想先讨论窗口平铺和快捷键。

replies.body_en: This is a demo reply; nothing was written to GitHub.

comments.body_en: I would like to talk about window tiling and keyboard shortcuts.

title_en: Which Plyra Desktop topics should we discuss first?
body_en:
This local sample demonstrates author labels, comment counts and reply previews.

Once connected to a real community repository, sign-in, new discussions, comments and edits to your own content will use the current user's identity. This prototype has no personal access token field and no administrator posting flow.
